blocks.en: Consider the biharmonic equation $\Delta\Delta u=0$ in the half-plane $y>0$ with boundary conditions $\Delta u=\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\Delta u=0$ on the line $y=0$. For every $\xi\in\mathbb{R}$, the function $u(x,y)=\exp(i\xi x-|\xi|y)$ is a solution. Hence the complementing condition does not hold.
blocks.zh: 考虑半平面 $y>0$ 中的双调和方程 $\Delta\Delta u=0$, 并在直线 $y=0$ 上施加边界条件 $\Delta u=\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\Delta u=0$. 对每个 $\xi\in\mathbb{R}$, 函数 $u(x,y)=\exp(i\xi x-|\xi|y)$ 都是解. 因而补条件不成立.

blocks.en: The complementing condition or its failure is not always as easy to verify as in the preceding examples. However, it can always be reduced to a purely algebraic problem. If we insert the ansatz \eqref{eq:complementing-decaying-tangential-mode} into \eqref{eq:complementing-frozen-principal-system}, we obtain a system of ODEs for $\bm{v}(\eta)$, which can as usual be solved by the ansatz $\bm{v}(\eta)=\exp(\lambda\eta)\bm{v}_0$. Ellipticity means that no roots $\lambda$ are imaginary, and if the coefficients of our system are real, then an equal number of roots must have positive and negative real parts. Let $\lambda_l^+(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi})$ denote the roots with positive real part. Then one obtains $m$ linearly independent solutions of \eqref{eq:complementing-frozen-principal-system} in the form $\exp(i\bm{\xi}\cdot(\bm{x}-\bm{x}_0)+\lambda_l^+\eta)\bm{u}_l$ (in the usual way, this may need to be modified by including powers of $\eta$ if there are repeated roots). It remains to be checked if any linear combination of these solutions satisfies the boundary conditions, which is a purely algebraic problem. For equivalent algebraic characterizations of the complementing conditions we refer to the literature, see \cite{ADN2}.
blocks.zh: 补条件成立与否并非总像前面的例子那样容易验证. 然而, 总可以将它归结为纯代数问题. 将待定形式 \eqref{eq:complementing-decaying-tangential-mode} 代入 \eqref{eq:complementing-frozen-principal-system}, 得到关于 $\bm{v}(\eta)$ 的 ODE 方程组, 可照常用待定形式 $\bm{v}(\eta)=\exp(\lambda\eta)\bm{v}_0$ 求解. 椭圆性意味着没有纯虚根 $\lambda$; 若方程组的系数为实数, 则正实部根与负实部根的数目必相等. 设 $\lambda_l^+(\bm{x}_0,\bm{\xi})$ 表示具有正实部的根. 于是得到 \eqref{eq:complementing-frozen-principal-system} 的 $m$ 个线性无关解, 形式为 $\exp(i\bm{\xi}\cdot(\bm{x}-\bm{x}_0)+\lambda_l^+\eta)\bm{u}_l$ (如通常那样, 若有重根, 可能需要引入 $\eta$ 的幂加以修改). 剩下需要检验的是, 这些解的某个线性组合是否满足边界条件, 这是纯代数问题. 补条件的等价代数刻画参见文献 \cite{ADN2}.
